parameters.query:
-- Move a confirmed appointment to another stylist. The EXCLUDE constraint is still the
-- judge: if the replacement took another booking in that window while the customer was
-- deciding, this changes nothing and says so. Always returns exactly one row.
WITH p AS (
  SELECT $1::text AS ref, $2::text AS to_stylist, $3::text AS from_stylist
), tgt AS (
  SELECT a.* FROM appointment a JOIN p ON a.ref = p.ref
), checks AS (
  SELECT
    (SELECT count(*) FROM tgt) > 0 AS found,
    (SELECT status FROM tgt) AS status,
    COALESCE((SELECT starts_at FROM tgt) > now(), false) AS in_future,
    -- The decline must still be about the stylist who actually holds it: a second decline
    -- after the move already happened must not bounce the customer around again.
    COALESCE((SELECT stylist_id FROM tgt) = (SELECT from_stylist FROM p), false) AS still_theirs,
    EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM stylist st, p WHERE st.id = p.to_stylist AND st.active) AS to_exists,
    EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM stylist_service ss, p, tgt
            WHERE ss.stylist_id = p.to_stylist AND ss.service_id = tgt.service_id) AS to_performs,
    EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM appointment b, p, tgt
            WHERE b.stylist_id = p.to_stylist AND b.status = 'confirmed' AND b.id <> tgt.id
              AND tstzrange(b.starts_at, b.ends_at) && tstzrange(tgt.starts_at, tgt.ends_at)) AS to_busy,
    EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM business_hours bh, p, tgt
            WHERE bh.stylist_id = p.to_stylist
              AND bh.weekday = EXTRACT(DOW FROM (tgt.starts_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Manila')::date)::smallint
              AND tgt.starts_at >= (((tgt.starts_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Manila')::date + bh.opens_at)  AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Manila')
              AND tgt.ends_at   <= (((tgt.starts_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Manila')::date + bh.closes_at) AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Manila')) AS to_hours_ok
), upd AS (
  UPDATE appointment a
     SET stylist_id = (SELECT to_stylist FROM p), updated_at = now(),
         notes = COALESCE(a.notes || ' | ', '') || 'reassigned from ' || (SELECT from_stylist FROM p)
    FROM p, checks c
   WHERE a.ref = p.ref AND a.status = 'confirmed' AND c.found AND c.in_future AND c.still_theirs
     AND c.to_exists AND c.to_performs AND c.to_hours_ok AND NOT c.to_busy
  RETURNING a.ref, a.stylist_id, a.starts_at, a.ends_at, a.service_id, a.client_id
)
SELECT json_build_object(
  'found', (SELECT found FROM checks), 'status', (SELECT status FROM checks),
  'in_future', (SELECT in_future FROM checks), 'still_theirs', (SELECT still_theirs FROM checks),
  'to_exists', (SELECT to_exists FROM checks), 'to_performs', (SELECT to_performs FROM checks),
  'to_busy', (SELECT to_busy FROM checks), 'to_hours_ok', (SELECT to_hours_ok FROM checks),
  'moved', (SELECT count(*) FROM upd) > 0,
  'booking', (SELECT json_build_object(
                'ref', u.ref, 'stylist_id', u.stylist_id, 'stylist_name', st.name,
                'service_name', sv.name,
                'starts_at_local', to_char(u.starts_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Manila','YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI'))
              FROM upd u JOIN stylist st ON st.id = u.stylist_id
                         JOIN service sv ON sv.id = u.service_id)
) AS result;

## 24 · tool: reassign booking

**In** `{booking_ref, from_stylist_id, to_stylist_id}` · **Out** `{ok:true, data}` or `{ok:false, reason}`

The same closed contract as tools 20-23. Re-checks everything at the moment of the move rather than trusting the moment of the offer: the appointment is still confirmed, still in the future, still held by the stylist who declined, and the replacement performs the service, works those hours and is still free.

`reason`: `invalid_input` · `booking_not_found` · `not_confirmed` · `already_started` · `already_reassigned` · `stylist_not_found` · `stylist_does_not_perform_service` · `outside_business_hours` · `replacement_busy` · `db_unavailable`
